description:
Moribund Stars 0.2.0-alpha

A story-oriented mod for Starsector. Very heavy work in progress.

Releases

Depends on LazyLib

For bug reports contact dark_watch through Discord ( USC or Corvus )

v0.2.0 (Changelog on GitHub)

Added most of Chapter II. Hopefully fixed the existing bugs and shouldn't have introduced new ones.

Approx.

15%

40% (!) of the main storyline in a 'functioning' state. Investigate Alpha Site to trigger the quest chain. Quest chain currently ends after the Very Serious Invitation.
